findings.title: Name your magic numbers
findings.message: Extract the glob pattern and directory path into named constants at the top of the file. Currently './src/infrastructure/db/schema/*.ts' and './src/infrastructure/db/migrations' are configuration values that should have descriptive names to clarify their purpose.

claims.claim: The glob pattern './src/infrastructure/db/schema/*.ts' should be extracted into a named constant.
claims.reason: The rule document states that literal values scattered through code should be pulled into named constants at the top of the file so the reader sees the intent. The finding cites this glob pattern as a configuration value that should have a descriptive name. The diff shows this pattern has been extracted into a named constant SCHEMA_GLOB at the top of the file, supporting the claim that extraction is appropriate.

claims.claim: The directory path './src/infrastructure/db/migrations' should be extracted into a named constant.
claims.reason: The rule document states that literal values should be pulled into named constants at the top of the file. The finding cites this directory path as a configuration value that should have a descriptive name. The diff shows this path has been extracted into a named constant MIGRATIONS_DIR at the top of the file, supporting the claim that extraction is appropriate.

claims.claim: The named constants should be placed at the top of the file.
claims.reason: The rule document explicitly states constants should be pulled 'at the top of the file (or a shared constants module)'. The diff shows SCHEMA_GLOB and MIGRATIONS_DIR are defined at lines 3-4, immediately after the import statement and before the export default statement, which is the top of the file. This directly supports the claim.

claims.claim: The named constants should have descriptive names to clarify their purpose.
claims.reason: The rule document states constants should be named 'so the reader sees the intent, not the value'. The finding explicitly states the constants should have 'descriptive names to clarify their purpose'. The diff shows the constants are named SCHEMA_GLOB and MIGRATIONS_DIR, which are descriptive names that clarify what each value represents (a schema glob pattern and a migrations directory). This supports the claim.
